canonClaims.claim: Lumos produces illumination at the caster's wand tip; Nox extinguishes that magical light.
Reparo can mend certain damaged objects, but mending a wand's exterior does not restore its damaged magic.

startAssumptions: Magically eligible adult learner owns an intact wand and has learned Lumos/Nox.
Nonmagical adult visitor owns a wand but has no magical source or learned casting method.
Learner is in a dim storage room; no mandatory quest, reward, or enemy is present.
Reparo is a later separate learned method not granted by this starting premise.
stateAndReaders: actor_id: string; wand_integrity: boolean; learned_spells: set<string>; current_light_state: enum[off, on]; room_id: string.
reader_actor_eligibility: checks if actor is magically eligible and owns a wand.
reader_spell_knowledge: checks if specific spell (e.g., Lumos) is in learned_spells.
reader_light_state: returns current_light_state for the actor's wand tip.

actions.name: cast_lumos
actions.preconditions: Actor is magically eligible, owns wand, and has learned Lumos. Current light state is off.
actions.effect: Sets current_light_state to 'on'. No mutation to wand integrity or other stats.
actions.sourceVsDesign: Source defines effect (H1); 'on' state persistence is design proposal (O1).

actions.name: cast_nox
actions.preconditions: Actor is magically eligible, owns wand, and has learned Nox. Current light state is on.
actions.effect: Sets current_light_state to 'off'. No mutation to wand integrity or other stats.
actions.sourceVsDesign: Source defines effect (H1); state transition logic is design proposal (O1).

actions.name: attempt_cast
actions.preconditions: Actor owns a wand but lacks magical eligibility or has not learned the specific spell.
actions.effect: Refusal: No state mutation, no new mastery, no item creation. Returns 'failed' status.
actions.sourceVsDesign: Design proposal (P1/O1) to prevent tool ownership from granting ability.

actions.name: leave_room
actions.preconditions: Actor is in a room and chooses to leave.
actions.effect: Updates room_id to null/exit. Light state persists if save policy allows.
actions.sourceVsDesign: Design proposal (O1) to allow free exit without quest completion.

missingConsumers: Eligibility reader: checks magical source vs tool ownership.
Spell knowledge reader: maps actor to learned spell set.
Light state consumer: tracks actor/wand scoped illumination.
Failure handler: ensures no mutation on unqualified cast attempts.

counterexamples: Visitor owns wand but casts Lumos: must fail because no magical source/method.
Initial learner attempts Reparo: refuse because it has not been learned. A separate later trained case may mend exterior damage but not restore damaged magic.
Adapter treats 'reeds' as magic: fails because scalar input/output lacks spell context.
Light turns on but room is not dark: effect persists but visibility consumer may ignore it.
futureWitness: Learner casts Lumos: light turns on. Casts Nox: light turns off.
Visitor casts Lumos: refusal, no light, no new knowledge gained.
Learner leaves room: light state persists under approved save policy.
Initial learner attempts Reparo: refusal with no mutation. In a separate learned-method case, verify physical mending does not restore damaged wand magic.
No source-specified mana or cooldown is applied to Lumos/Nox.
Schema remains inert proposal until adapter/consumer code is implemented.
numericalPolicy: No source-specified mana, cooldowns, or costs. Numerical values are design proposals only if added later.
